Customs and courtesies didn't change, and gay males still had to live up to the male APFT (Army Physical Fitness Test) standards. AR 670-1, the Army regulation the covers the wear and appearance of uniforms, didn't come into play either as gay men still obviously had to adhere to the male guidelines.
